results.generated_sql:
WITH Top1Percent AS (
    SELECT 
        genre,
        COUNT(*) AS count_top
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance,
         unnest(string_split(genres, ', ')) AS genre
    WHERE members >= (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY members) FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance)
    GROUP BY genre
),
TotalDistribution AS (
    SELECT 
        genre,
        COUNT(*) AS count_total
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance,
         unnest(string_split(genres, ', ')) AS genre
    GROUP BY genre
)
SELECT 
    t.genre,
    t.count_total,
    COALESCE(p.count_top, 0) AS count_top,
    (COALESCE(p.count_top, 0) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(count_top) FROM Top1Percent)) AS pct_top,
    (t.count_total * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(count_total) FROM TotalDistribution)) AS pct_total
FROM TotalDistribution t
LEFT JOIN Top1Percent p ON t.genre = p.genre
ORDER BY pct_top DESC;

results.question: Members 상위 1% 작품의 장르 분포 vs 전체 작품의 장르 분포
results.generated_sql:
WITH genre_unnested AS (
    SELECT 
        trim(unnest(string_split(genres, ','))) AS genre,
        members_tier
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
    WHERE genres IS NOT NULL AND genres != 'Unknown'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_all FROM genre_unnested
),
top_1_percent_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_top FROM genre_unnested WHERE members_tier = 'Top 1%'
)
SELECT 
    g.genre,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.members_tier = 'Top 1%') * 100.0 / tpc.total_top, 2) AS top_1_pct_distribution,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / tc.total_all, 2) AS all_anime_pct_distribution
FROM genre_unnested g, total_counts tc, top_1_percent_counts tpc
GROUP BY 1, tc.total_all, tpc.total_top
ORDER BY top_1_pct_distribution DESC;
